plain_english_summary: A defender illegally impedes an opponent's movement without establishing or maintaining legal guarding position.
criteria_checklist: Defender is moving into the opponent's path at or after contact
Defender does not establish legal guarding position before contact
Contact meaningfully affects the ball handler's speed, balance, rhythm, or path
official_rule_reference: NBA Rule 12, Section II - Personal Fouls; Blocking

plain_english_summary: An offensive player with or without the ball illegally runs into or pushes through a defender who has legal guarding position.
criteria_checklist: Defender establishes legal guarding position before contact
Offensive player initiates significant torso contact
Defender is not moving forward into the opponent at the moment of contact
official_rule_reference: NBA Rule 12, Section II - Personal Fouls; Charging

plain_english_summary: A player takes too many steps after gathering the ball or illegally moves the pivot foot without dribbling.
criteria_checklist: Player gathers or controls the ball
Player takes more than the allowed steps before passing, shooting, or dribbling
Pivot foot is lifted and returned to the floor before releasing the ball

plain_english_summary: A player uses hands or arms to hold, push, check, or redirect an opponent illegally.
criteria_checklist: Defender places hands or arms on opponent
Contact restricts, redirects, holds, or slows the opponent
Contact is not incidental to a normal basketball play
official_rule_reference: NBA Rule 12, Section II - Illegal Use of Hands

plain_english_summary: A player illegally touches a shot while it is descending toward the basket and has a chance to score.
criteria_checklist: Ball is on its downward flight
Ball has a chance to enter the basket
Player touches the ball before it legally misses or scores
official_rule_reference: NBA Rule 11 - Goaltending and Basket Interference

plain_english_summary: A player commits unnecessary or excessive contact against an opponent.
criteria_checklist: Contact is unnecessary for a normal basketball play
Contact is excessive, dangerous, or targets a vulnerable opponent
Impact level, wind-up, follow-through, or body area increases severity
official_rule_reference: NBA Rule 12, Section II - Flagrant Fouls
